sections.heading: Handyman Services Available in Downton, SP5
sections.body: FixWell Services provides comprehensive handyman and property maintenance cover across Downton and the SP5 postcode. Downton residents most frequently call us for carpentry repairs to original timber features, internal painting and decorating, period door and window maintenance, minor plumbing repairs, shelf installation in solid-walled properties, fence and garden work, gutter clearing, and emergency callouts. We also carry out furniture assembly, electrical repairs within legal handyman scope, and general odd jobs for homeowners who need a reliable tradesperson without a lengthy wait. All work is fully insured, and we provide a clear quote before starting, whether you are booking a single task or a full property refresh.

sections.heading: Downton's Period Housing and Conservation Area Character
sections.body: Downton is one of the most historically significant large villages in Wiltshire, and its housing stock reflects that. The Borough, Downton's unusually wide central street, is a scheduled ancient monument, flanked by 17th and 18th century cottages, flint-and-brick dwellings, and Victorian townhouses that together form one of the more intact historic streetscapes in the county. Much of this area falls within a conservation area, and a proportion of individual buildings are listed. Beyond The Borough, the rest of the village contains Victorian terraces, inter-war semis, and post-1990 estate housing on the periphery. Period properties in Downton present characteristic maintenance challenges: original sash and casement windows requiring cord replacement and draught sealing, lime-mortared walls that need careful repair rather than modern cement, internal timber features (skirting boards, dado rails, panel doors) that need re-fixing and repainting, and older plumbing in cottages with cast iron or lead pipework requiring sympathetic repair. FixWell handles all of this work with the appropriate materials and methods.
